en: The image is an aerial view of a historic European city center. Dominating the upper left is a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers, surrounded by leafy parks and older buildings. In the lower center is a round building with a dome, located on a prominent square with a statue and fountains. The architecture is varied, featuring both medieval and 19th-century urban forms.
